data.summary: The Kreis Musterdithmarschen (hunting authority) rejected Tjark Beispielholm's application for a three-year hunting license (Jagdschein) because the submitted hunting liability insurance proof expired on 30 June 2026. The authority will issue the license without a new application once a valid insurance confirmation is submitted.
data.explanation: The authority cannot issue your hunting license because your proof of hunting liability insurance has expired. You don't need to file a new application — simply send in a current, valid insurance confirmation and the license will be issued. If you disagree with the rejection itself, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline for this. If you miss that deadline, the rejection becomes final. No payment is currently due.
